title: Back to Thailand.
subject: Back to Thailand: twelve new windows into my exchange
paragraphs: Twelve new windows into my study exchange.

I have been looking back through my Thailand photos and Polarsteps notes. Twelve more photographs now sit alongside the story of my three-month exchange, with memories of settling into student life, Bangkok from above, lake days in Khao Sok and a family visit before I left.
There is also a small travel notebook to help you follow the journey between the chapters.

photo.alt: Longtail boats beneath the limestone hills of Khao Sok
